title: alangium villosum subsp. bussyanum
intro: Alangium villosum subsp. bussyanum, commonly known as the Himalayan alangium, is a plant species belonging to the Alangiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alangium villosum subsp. bussyanum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
